runners.name: Hullabaloo Ray Ray
runners.comment: HULLABALOO RAY RAY raced three wide in closest aim of the leader, came under coaxing with five-sixteenths to go and advanced on that rival to seize command just outside the quarter pole and then spun three wide into upper stretch, went clear under a light drive and was ridden out to the finish.

runners.name: Its Saturday Night
runners.comment: ITS SATURDAY NIGHT got bumped at the start by RHYTHM RIOT, who bobbled outwards, showed the way in hand along the inside and then just off the inside through moderate splits, came under coaxing three furlongs out and came under increased pressure to the outside, got displaced from the front just outside the quarter pole and cornered just off the inside into upper stretch, proved no match for the top one while running on well clear of the rest to be along second best.

runners.name: Johnny Hockey
runners.comment: JOHNNY HOCKEY bobbled at the break, chased four then three wide coming under ride near the five-sixteenths pole, cut the corner into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Rhythm Riot
runners.comment: RHYTHM RIOT bobbled at the start recovering outwards into ITS SATURDAY NIGHT, chased along the inside and then just off the inside under urging from the seven-sixteenths marker, went two to three wide at the top of the stretch and faltered in the drive.

runners.name: Twirly
runners.comment: TWIRLY moved in early, settled on the inside, advanced closer late on the backstretch, was asked on the far turn then moved to the two path late on that bend, rallied to make a bid at the quarter-pole, took the lead in upper stretch and drew clear under steady urging.

runners.name: Livin the Breeze
runners.comment: LIVIN THE BREEZE bumped with HEAVEN'S BOLT at the start, settled in the two path, was asked on the far turn, turned into upper stretch under a drive and narrowly earned the place while no match for the winner.

runners.name: Raging Bloom
runners.comment: RAGING BLOOM angled in while establishing a forward position, saved ground under a tight hold on the first turn, moved up to prompt the pace on the inside then drew even with the leader, took the advantage with a half-mile to run, vied inside on the far turn, inched clear at the five-sixteenths pole, was asked just inside the quarter-pole, lost the advantage to the winner in upper stretch and weakened then was caught for the place but was clear for the show.

runners.name: Intothewilderness
runners.comment: INTOTHEWILDERNESS dropped back early, raced in the three path on the first turn, settled on the outside, was asked in the four then five path on the far turn and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: Smokin Hot Blonde
runners.comment: SMOKIN HOT BLONDE went around the first turn in the three path, settled off the pace, moved closer late on the backstretch, was given her cue in the three then four path on the far turn, chased into upper stretch and came up empty.

runners.name: On a Summer Day
runners.comment: ON A SUMMER DAY brushed with LIL' HOTTIE at the start, moved out while up close early, raced in the three path on the first turn, prompted the pace on the outside under restraint, was asked in the three path on the far turn then chased the leader, dropped back into the stretch and tired.

runners.name: Heaven's Bolt
runners.comment: HEAVEN'S BOLT bumped with LIVING THE BREEZE at the start, settled on the inside, dropped back leaving the backstretch and faltered then was eased but walked off.

runners.name: Lil' Hottie
runners.comment: LIL' HOTTIE brushed with a rival at the start, went to the front, rounded the first turn in the two path, lost the lead at the half-mile pole, dropped back while two path to the inside on the far turn and also faltered then was eased but walked off.

runners.name: Flying Hawley
runners.comment: FLYING HAWLEY broke out a step at the start, raced three then two wide through the first turn before heading four then three paths off the inside down the backstretch, went three wide through the far turn coming under coaxing inside the five-sixteenths marker, continued three wide into upper stretch, rallied to collar the leader a furlong out, tussled with that rival briefly before edging away in the late stages to prevail.

runners.name: Hypnotica
runners.comment: HYPNOTICA established the front from the get go and showed the way in hand along the inside patiently handled until let out spinning from the two path into upper stretch, dug in under growing threat to the outside and was caught a furlong out, ran on latched on until inside the sixteenth marker, when shaken off late.

runners.name: Candidly
runners.comment: CANDIDLY chased along the inside under a ride from three furlongs out, angled four wide into upper stretch, weakened in the late stages while along for the show honors.

runners.name: Ifweonlyhavelove (FR)
runners.comment: IFWEONLYHAVELOVE (FR) saved ground at the tail of the field coming under urging three furlongs out, continued in the indie route into upper stretch, passed tired rivals to the finish.

runners.name: Yurak
runners.comment: YURAK raced three then two wide in closest aim of the leader, came under urging with five-sixteenths to go, spun three wide for home and tired.

runners.name: Friendshipandlove
runners.comment: FRIENDSHIPANDLOVE two to three wide in pursuit, came under urging at the three-eighths pole, angled four to five wide into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Hot Property
runners.comment: HOT PROPERTY tracked the pace on the outside, was urged along passing the eleven-sixteenths pole, chased in the four then three path on the turn, turned into upper stretch under a left-handed crop, pursued the winner under a prolonged drive while inside of PRIVATE FLIGHT, gained into the final sixteenth and got up under a hand-ride in the final strides to narrowly prevail.

runners.name: Franklin Delano
runners.comment: FRANKLIN DELANO showed the way while outside of foes and well out in the track, moved in late on the backstretch, vied in the three then two path on the turn, moved clear with three furlongs to run, was asked near the quarter-pole then came under a right-handed crop in upper stretch, switched to a left-handed crop at the furlong marker, remained clear while shortening stride into the final sixteenth, swapped back to a right-handed crop late and was nailed in the final strides while clear for the place.

runners.name: Private Flight
runners.comment: PRIVATE FLIGHT dropped back after the start, settled off the pace, was urged along passing the eleven-sixteenths pole, shifted from the two path to the four path very early on the turn then gained on the leader, chased outside the winner into the final furlong and weakened but was far clear for the show.

runners.name: Chris's Song
runners.comment: CHRIS'S SONG broke out then was corrected with a tug of the left-rein, settled off the early pace, moved off the inside while getting closer with seven furlongs to run, advanced to prompt the pace, dropped from the two path to the inside on the turn, lost touch with the runner-up late on that bend and tired.

runners.name: Elko County
runners.comment: ELKO COUNTY broke a bit slow, dropped well behind the rest of the field, saved ground on the turn, came into the stretch in the three path and was no factor.

runners.name: E Z Bourbon
runners.comment: E Z BOURBON moved in while showing speed, prompted the pace, dropped back with five furlongs to run, chased inside to the two path on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Munny Problem
runners.comment: MUNNY PROBLEM advanced after the start to be forwardly placed inside before taking over the front nearing five and a half furlongs to run, showed the way in hand three then two paths off the inside under some pressure from FRENCHQUARTER NOTE to the outside, had that rival advance and dueled through the turn coming under urging near the quarter pole, took the inside route into upper stretch, dug in under threat to the eighth pole before shaking clear in the late stages kept to task.

runners.name: Turbo Launch
runners.comment: TURBO LAUNCH chased four then three wide under a ride from the five-sixteenths pole, tipped four to five wide into upper stretch, offered up a mild kick to just secure the place honors on the wire.

runners.name: Frenchquarter Note
runners.comment: FRENCHQUARTER NOTE led briefly early on before being displaced by the top one near five and a half furlongs to run, prompted that rival from the outside four then three paths off the rail down the backstretch before tucking to the two path into the turn and advancing to duel through the bend coming under a ride inside five-sixteenths to go, spun just off the inside into upper stretch, dug in under a drive latched on to the eighth pole, ran on to the finish getting shaken off by the winner late, then got nailed on the line for the place honors.

runners.name: Instantly
runners.comment: INSTANTLY chased three then two wide under a ride from the five-sixteenths pole, swung three to four wide into upper stretch, kept on to the end.

runners.name: Battle
runners.comment: BATTLE came together with ESKE CASTLE and traded three bumps at the start, the last one even ricocheting off that rival and catching KLIMT MASTER in the hind end and turning that foe slightly inwards, then got steadied after the start, crossed to chase just off the inside down the backstretch and through the turn, went six wide into upper stretch and passed tired rivals to the finish.

runners.name: Eske Castle (IRE)
runners.comment: ESKE CASTLE (IRE) traded three bumps at the start with BATTLE, chased four then three paths off the rail down the backstretch before tucking to the two path through the turn, continued just off the inside into upper stretch and weakened.

runners.name: Oligarch
runners.comment: OLIGARCH chased along the inside under encouragement from the five-sixteenths marker, spun two to three wide for home and tired in the stretch.

runners.name: Klimt Master
runners.comment: KLIMT MASTER got bumped in the hind quarters after the start and was turned in by BATTLE, crossed to the inside soon after and chased along the rail, angled four wide into upper stretch and made no impact.

runners.name: Crowned Moment (GB)
runners.comment: CROWNED MOMENT (GB) chased just off the inside and then along the inside under a ride with five-sixteenths remaining, continued in the inside route into upper stretch and faltered in the drive.

runners.name: Inflect
runners.comment: INFLECT was reserved towards the rear, went around the turn in the three then four path, rallied in the five path into the stretch, closed fast to get the lead inside the three-sixteenths pole and drew away under steady urging.

runners.name: Sellonthenews (GB)
runners.comment: SELLONTHENEWS (GB) was reserved while unhurried at the back, raced under a very strong hold from the five-eighths pole to the half-mile pole, shifted from the two path to the four path on the turn, came into the stretch in the six path and improved to get the place.

runners.name: Kindness Wins
runners.comment: KINDNESS WINS settled towards the rear, saved ground on the turn, came off the rail late on that bend, angled out in upper stretch and improved for the show.

runners.name: Coastal Beauty
runners.comment: COASTAL BEAUTY was hustled from the gate, settled on the outside, chased in the three path on the turn, made a bid near the five-sixteenths pole, lost touch with the winner in upper stretch, chased that rival into the final furlong and weakened.

runners.name: Coastal Conflict
runners.comment: COASTAL CONFLICT was well placed down the backstretch, raced inside to the two path on the turn, moved out while asked for her best in upper stretch and came up empty.

runners.name: Norah Begorrah
runners.comment: NORAH BEGORRAH prompted the pace under a tight hold, drew even with the leader late on the backstretch, vied along the rail on the turn and tired.

runners.name: Cotton Queen
runners.comment: COTTON QUEEN veered out at the start, moved up to get the lead then showed the way on the outside, vied in the two path on the turn, lost the lead at the five-sixteenths pole and faded.

runners.name: Palace Joy
runners.comment: PALACE JOY settled on the outside, went around most of the turn in the three path then shifted to the four path, bumped with HARMONY MILL at the quarter-pole and failed to threaten.

runners.name: Harmony Mill
runners.comment: HARMONY MILL settled between horses, rounded most of the turn in the two path then went to the three path, bumped with PALACE JOY at the quarter-pole and was no factor.

runners.name: Royal Victoria
runners.comment: ROYAL VICTORIA settled on the inside, was urged along on the turn and faltered then was eased in the final furlong but walked off.

runners.name: Dreamlike
runners.comment: DREAMLIKE four paths off the inside in pursuit down the backstretch, tucked three wide five furlongs from home, advanced on the top pair half a mile out to vie three wide outside that pair with seven-sixteenths to run, knocked heads coming under coaxing near the five-sixteenths pole, swung three wide into upper stretch and seized command straightened away into upper stretch, drew clear under a drive and was geared down in the late stages.

runners.name: Secured Landing
runners.comment: SECURED LANDING advanced after the start to take command seven furlongs from home, showed the way in hand along the inside before being joined first by TIME TO WIN half a mile from home and then DREAMLIKE with seven-sixteenths remaining, vied inside a pair of rivals through the turn coming under coaxing three furlongs out, took the inside route into upper stretch narrowly headed for the front, proved no match for the top one and ran on through to the finish to garner the place honors.

runners.name: Time to Win
runners.comment: TIME TO WIN led early on before conceding the front to the aforementioned foe settling three paths off the rail in closest aim of that rival, tucked to the two path into the turn and advanced to briefly duel before vying between barn mates through the turn coming under coaxing near the quarter pole, poked a nose in front spinning from the two path into upper stretch before being displaced from narrow command straightened away, proved no match for the winner while running on through to the finish.

runners.name: Kinetic
runners.comment: KINETIC brushed the off side stall at the start, chased just off the inside and then along the inside under prolonged encouragement from the half mile pole, tipped back to the two path midway on the turn before angling four wide into upper stretch and kept on to miss for the show honors at the finish.

runners.name: Adero
runners.comment: ADERO two to three wide in pursuit, got coaxed along with five-sixteenths remaining, angled five to six wide into upper stretch, tired.

runners.name: Noble Heritage
runners.comment: NOBLE HERITAGE chased five paths off the inside down the backstretch, tucked four then three wide through the turn coming under prolonged urging half a mile from home, tipped back four wide with seven-sixteenths to go, went seven wide at the top of the stretch, and tired.

runners.name: Sfumato
runners.comment: SFUMATO was bumped at the start and forced out into another foe then checked while squeezed back, settled well off the pace, went around the turn in the two path, angled out in upper stretch, rallied outside into the final furlong and closed strongly to get up in the final sixteenth and prevail.

runners.name: Where's Your Boom
runners.comment: WHERE'S YOUR BOOM bumped with SFUMATO at the start then dropped back, was urged along well off the pace, moved from the four path to the six path on the turn, gained coming to the quarter-pole, dropped to the three path into upper stretch.

runners.name: Mr R T
runners.comment: MR R T bumped with a rival at the start, was hustled to the lead then showed the way with a clear advantage, dropped from the three path to the two path early on the turn, came under a left-handed crop outside the furlong marker, was collared by the runner-up outside the sixteenth-pole and weakened but was well clear for the show.

runners.name: Go Dharma
runners.comment: GO DHARMA chased the pace on the outside, went around the turn in four to five path and lacked the needed response.

runners.name: True Adirondacker
runners.comment: TRUE ADIRONDACKER came out at the start and bumped with BIG TIME STORY, moved off the inside around the three-quarter pole, chased in the two path on the turn and came up empty.

runners.name: Chess Match
runners.comment: CHESS MATCH was urged along off the pace, went around most of the turn in the three path then shifted to the four path and failed to rally.

runners.name: Big Time Story
runners.comment: BIG TIME STORY was bumped at the start then forced out into another foe, tracked the pace, chased inside on the turn and tired.

runners.name: Authentic Legend
runners.comment: AUTHENTIC LEGEND bumped with a foe at the start, was urged along towards the front then chased the pace, dropped from the four path to the three path on the turn and capitulated.

runners.name: Thespian
runners.comment: THESPIAN was urged along off the pace, dropped back late on the backstretch, retreated in the four path on the turn and was eased but walked off.
